issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
covered_actors: academic, public, and private sector researchers
implementation_notes: This is the first draft of the NIST AI RMF, published March 17, 2022. Part 3 was not yet developed at time of publication. The framework is explicitly voluntary and not a compliance mechanism; it is intended to be used alongside existing laws, regulations, and mandatory guidance. Developed under the National AI Initiative Act of 2020 (P.L. 116-283). Framework covers all sectors, organization sizes, and AI maturity levels.
